sub: Oversized graphic tees, designed in India, released in small numbered drops. If your store would look better with them on the rack, talk to us.

why.title: Original artwork.
why.text: Clean front, loud back. Nothing on your rack looks like it.

why.title: Small numbered drops.
why.text: Stock that doesn't sit for a season.

why.title: We do the work.
why.text: Display, restocks, and we send our Instagram audience to your store.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: 12 pieces per design (same colour), in a size pack: S 1 / M 3 / L 4 / XL 3 / XXL 1. You can adjust the size split, keeping the same total.

terms.label: How tiers work
terms.value: Counted per design and colour, across all sizes. Different designs don't add together.

terms.label: GST
terms.value: All prices are exclusive of GST. 5% GST is charged extra on a GST invoice.

terms.label: Payment
terms.value: 50% to confirm the order, 50% before dispatch.

terms.label: Freight
terms.value: Free on orders above ₹25,000 (excl. GST). Below that, charged at actuals.

terms.label: MRP
terms.value: Printed on every tee. Stores sell at MRP.

terms.label: Defects
terms.value: Report within 48 hours of delivery with photos. Misprints and damaged pieces are replaced.

terms.label: Returns
terms.value: No returns on outright orders. Exchanges for size or defect only.

terms.label: Trial order
terms.value: First-time stores: one 12-piece trial per design at the 12–20 price. Pay-when-sold trials (30 days, up to 24 pieces) for selected stores, by agreement.

terms.label: Validity
terms.value: Prices valid for 90 days from the date above. They may be revised if garment costs change.

terms.label: Exclusives
terms.value: Area-exclusive designs by written agreement, on 21+ pieces per design.

gstLine: GST invoice provided on every order.
